prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 desktop documentation homepage design comp for an open-source Dart terminal UI framework
Input images: Image 1 is a visual-system board; Image 2 is a craft-level homepage example. Carry over the pure black-and-white palette, pixel-crisp bar density, sine lattice discipline, tabular numerics, and total environmental commitment. Do not copy their fictitious product, layout, text, metrics, navigation, or cards.
Primary request: Design the first viewport and beginning of the second fold for Noir documentation as a readable data-sublime field where the retained rendering pipeline resolves from dense cell signals into a working terminal frame. It must remain clearly usable documentation, not a data-art poster.
Structure: A hairline top navigation with NOIR, 0.0.1-alpha.3, Start, Concepts, Guides, Widgets, API, GitHub. The hero is one full-width seeded field: on the left, dense vertical cell bars and tabular indices; through the center, a single sine path labeled Widget, Element, RenderObject, Paint; on the right, the field resolves into a crisp 80×24 terminal frame. The exact headline and quick-start command occupy a calm readable window cut into the field, not a floating card. The next fold starts with four signal-channel rows for Start, Build, Test, Extend.
Content: Exact headline "Reactive terminal UI, measured in cells." Supporting line "Noir brings Flutter-like widgets and retained state to Dart terminal apps." Command "$ dart pub add noir". Architecture line "Widgets declare. Elements preserve identity. RenderObjects layout and record paint." Actions "Get started" and "Read the guides".
Style/medium: Pure black and pure white only. One expressive monospace display face for signal labels and numerics, paired with a restrained proportional sans for explanations. Hairline rules, barcode fields, tabular indices, seeded sine lattice, occasional solid inversion for the active action. Dense field at the hero edges, quiet reading windows around essential text.
Composition/framing: 2048×1152 landscape, full browser viewport, one dominant field rather than a card grid, enough second-fold content to show sustainable documentation rhythm.
Interaction implied: SOURCE / FRAME / TREE changes which signal channel is emphasized; the current channel inverts from black to white. Reduced motion holds one still high-contrast frame.
Constraints: Professional open-source documentation; clear prerelease status; no grey and no color; no invented metrics, testimonials, benchmarks, or company logos; all visible text must be spelled correctly; use no more text than specified.
Avoid: generic SaaS layout, fake analytics dashboard, green terminal cliché, neon glow, rounded cards, gradients, glass, soft shadows, decorative icons, fake data claims, QR codes, watermarks.
